views.name: superhero_denorm_with_race_and_lookups
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  s.full_name AS full_name,
  r.race AS race,
  g.gender AS gender,
  ec.colour AS eye_colour,
  hc.colour AS hair_colour,
  sc.colour AS skin_colour,
  p.publisher_name AS publisher_name,
  a.alignment AS alignment
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
LEFT JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
LEFT JOIN colour sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
views.description: Denormalized superhero rows joined to human-readable lookup fields (race, gender, colours, publisher, alignment). Useful for queries that need textual attributes (race text, gender text, publisher name, colour names) without repeating joins each time.

views.name: hero_attributes_and_powers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ha.hero_id AS hero_id,
  s.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  ha.attribute_id AS attribute_id,
  a.attribute_name AS attribute_name,
  ha.attribute_value AS attribute_value,
  hp.power_id AS power_id,
  sp.power_name AS power_name
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
LEFT JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = ha.hero_id
LEFT JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
grain: hero_attribute.hero_id x hero_power.power_id (one row per hero-attribute-power combination)
views.description: Row-level mapping of each hero to their attributes and powers (attribute id/name/value and power id/name). Useful for filtering or aggregating heroes by capabilities or specific powers/attribute thresholds.

LEFT JOIN gender g ON sc.gender_id = g.id

views.name: hero_attributes_powers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  s.full_name AS full_name,
  COALESCE(ha.attr_count, 0) AS attribute_count,
  COALESCE(hp.pow_count, 0) AS power_count,
  ha.max_attribute_value AS max_attribute_value,
  ha.min_attribute_value AS min_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    hero_id,
    COUNT(*) AS attr_count,
    MAX(attribute_value) AS max_attribute_value,
    MIN(attribute_value) AS min_attribute_value
  FROM hero_attribute
  GROUP BY hero_id
) ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    hero_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS pow_count
  FROM hero_power
  GROUP BY hero_id
) hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
views.description: One-row-per-hero aggregated lists of attribute-value pairs and power names to support queries that filter or group heroes by having certain attributes or powers. Keeps counts and raw attribute values for downstream aggregation.
